# `aitbc mining start`

Start mining with a specified wallet and optional thread count.

## Usage

```bash
aitbc mining start [OPTIONS]
```

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--wallet-name` | text | — | yes | The Wallet name. |
| `--threads` | integer | `1` | no | Number of mining threads |
| `--rpc-url` | text | — | no | Blockchain RPC URL |

## Examples

```bash
aitbc mining start --wallet-name <wallet_name>
RPC_URL=http://127.0.0.1:8202/rpc
aitbc mining start --wallet-name <wallet_name> --rpc-url "$RPC_URL"
```
